description: A triangle low-frequency oscillator that puts out up to sixteen channels at once, their phases spread evenly around one cycle

params.text: Sets how many channels come out, 1 to 16
Sets the speed in beats per minute, 0.1 to 500
Sets the voltage at one end of the triangle, -10V to +10V
Sets the voltage at the other end of the triangle, -10V to +10V

inputs.text: Replaces the Rate knob while a cable is patched: -10V gives 0.1 beats per minute, 0V gives 250, and +10V gives 500
Replaces the Min knob while a cable is patched, a volt of output range per volt
Replaces the Max knob while a cable is patched, a volt of output range per volt

outputs.text: The triangle, with as many channels as the Poly knob is set to

notes: every control input replaces its knob outright rather than being added to it, so that knob does nothing while a cable is patched
the channels are one wave at spread phases, not separate waves: useful for scanning a wavetable or driving a bank of voices out of step
